description:
### Test 12 (2026-11-24)

**Features**
- The grouped card menu fits the screen without scrolling
- Reset order sits in the top bar beside the title
- Closing search opened from the menu goes back to the menu
- No card is marked as selected on first open
- Hidden parts fade out with their red outline, no leftover red line
- Comparisons open in their final shape, with labels already in place
- Scrolling is 20% less sensitive, with the phone's own fling feel
- The glass is 30% softer everywhere
- The screen menu is 15% darker

**Bug Fixes**
- Morphe Manager shows each release's changes (it showed the same one-line text every time)
